severity_name: SEVERE SLOP WARNING — TERRAIN RECLASSIFICATION ADVISORY
headline: SEVERE SLOP WARNING: MAJORITY-CROSSOVER FRONT MAKES LANDFALL AS SYNTHETIC TEXT QUIETLY BECOMES THE DOMINANT SURFACE FEATURE OF THE KNOWN INTERNET, FORCING THE SERVICE TO RECLASSIFY SLOP FROM 'WEATHER' TO 'CLIMATE'
advisory: The Service advises residents that slop has crossed a threshold from passing condition to standing landscape. What was formerly reported as intermittent precipitation must now, per revised charts, be logged as the prevailing terrain itself. Genuine human writing persists in sheltered valleys and is not endangered, but residents are reminded it now constitutes the minority ground cover and should be treated as a protected habitat.

regional_outlook.conditions: Dense thought-leadership haze with roughly two in five updates showing synthetic origin. Visibility reduced to a single inspirational sentence per line.
Standing floodwater of auto-generated articles now covers more than half the basin floor. Residents wading toward a simple answer report the bottom has dropped out entirely.
Steady inflow of personalized outreach addressed to 'Hi {FIRST_NAME}.' Tide expected to rise with every quarterly sales cycle.
Accumulating banks of same-day paperbacks on trending topics. Publication limits holding the drift at a slow crawl rather than an avalanche.
Scattered reply-guy swarms with high synthetic content. Countermeasures deployed; countermeasures also appear partly synthetic.

specimen.status: Thriving; now the apex grazer of the LinkedIn Plateau.
specimen.habitat: Open-plan feeds, before 9 a.m. local time, where it feeds on professional self-doubt.
specimen.field_marks: Opens with a one-line emotional bombshell set off by itself. Proceeds in single-sentence paragraphs descending like stairs. Features a stranger — a janitor, a barista, a child — who delivers unlicensed MBA wisdom. Terminates in a one-word interrogative.
specimen.call: A stranger at the airport taught me more about Q3 leadership than any boardroom ever could. Agree?
specimen.confusion_species: Can be mistaken for an actual workplace anecdote from a real manager. The genuine article is distinguishable by a boring specific name, a detail that makes the teller look slightly bad, and the total absence of a tidy lesson.

spotter_tip: If a post about one person's quiet act of kindness ends by asking YOU to repost it, you are not reading a story — you are standing in the feeding ground.
tomorrow: Majority conditions persist; sheltered pockets of human writing holding, cherish accordingly.

confirmed_sighting.report: A year-end review reports that media-intelligence firm Meltwater found mentions of 'AI slop' rose ninefold from 2024, while SEO firm Graphite estimated AI-generated articles now exceed half of all English-language web content; Pinterest and YouTube have added tools letting users limit AI material. The Service notes the majority crossover with professional calm and no further comment.
